description: This file defines models and a fetcher for searching ETFs via the Intrinio API, including query parameters, data models, and data fetching/transforming logic.

classes.name: IntrinioEtfSearchQueryParams
classes.description: Defines query parameters for Intrinio ETF search, including optional exchange filter.

classes.name: IntrinioEtfSearchData
classes.description: Represents ETF search result data with various identifiers and metadata.

classes.name: IntrinioEtfSearchFetcher
classes.description: Handles fetching and transforming ETF search data from Intrinio API.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Converts a dictionary of parameters into an IntrinioEtfSearchQueryParams instance.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches ETF data from Intrinio API, handling pagination and errors.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Transforms raw API data into structured IntrinioEtfSearchData objects, filtering by query if provided.
